name: A1 — ESLint 8 → 9 flat-config migration and the cwd/basePath fix
description:
**Slice 2/8 of the rule-unification track** (`addon-repository-actions-config` repo, `doc/plans/rule-unification-a1.md`). Previous: A0. Next: A2.

Measured on a scratch port of `main`: `node test/selftest.js` went from 5 failures to 1 (a deliberate snapshot update). Final shape: 10 files, ~115 changed lines, 1 new 18-line file, 1 line of `expected.json`.

### Why this is its own slice

`.eslintrc.js` cannot survive: `context.getScope()` was removed in ESLint 9 in both config modes, and this repo's custom rules use it. ESLint 10 additionally removes `getSourceCode()`/`getFilename()`/`getCwd()`, drops `@eslint/eslintrc` (`FlatCompat` unavailable), and rejects `new Linter({ configType: "eslintrc" })`. Doing the flat-config port as its own slice attributes every selftest-fixture change to one cause. Stylelint is **not** touched here (stays 15.11; shared package peers `>=15 <18`).

### The failure this slice must not ship

In flat config, `cwd` becomes `basePath` and every file outside it is dropped. `linters/eslint-linter.js` sets `cwd: ROOT` (the tool's own dir), but CI runs `review.js` against `src/`, a sibling of `review-tool/` — outside `basePath`. Result: `"File ignored because outside of base path"` at WARNING (not ERROR), so the JS half of the gate silently reports zero blockers and the workflow goes green. Introduced in ESLint 9.5.0 (not present 9.0–9.4), hence the shared packages floor peers at `>=9.5.0`. Fix: derive `cwd` from the common ancestor of the resolved file list, not the tool's own directory. The existing selftest cannot catch this — `good/`/`bad/` both live inside `ROOT` — so a new fixture for the real CI topology (target dir outside the tool tree) is part of DoD.

### Scope

- `.eslintrc.js` → `eslint.flat.config.js` (CommonJS `module.exports = [...]`). `eslint:recommended` → `@eslint/js`; `env` → `languageOptions.globals` via `globals` package. **Do not spread **`js.configs.recommended` (61 rules on ESLint 9 vs 64 on 10) — enumerate rules explicitly since A2 publishes this config for ESLint-10 consumers too.
- Remove/replace removed `ESLint` options: `useEslintrc`, `resolvePluginsRelativeTo`, `overrideConfigFile` (point at flat config), `cwd` (see above), `overrideConfig.parserOptions.sourceType` → `overrideConfig.languageOptions.sourceType`.
- Mechanical substitution across the ~25 removed-API call sites: `context.getScope()` → `context.sourceCode.getScope(node)`, `context.getSourceCode()` → `context.sourceCode`, `context.getFilename()` → `context.filename` (heaviest in `rules/shoptet-no-core-overwrite.js`).
- Two behavioural deltas to apply deliberately: `no-unused-vars`'s `caughtErrors` default flipped `"none"` → `"all"` in ESLint 9 — set it back to `'none'` explicitly or every unused `catch (error) {}` becomes a mass false-positive blocker. `no-implicit-globals` now also fires on `shoptet = {}` in module mode, duplicating `no-global-assign` — decide: accept the extra `expected.json` line, or drop `no-implicit-globals` from `RELIABLE_RULES`.
- Dependency moves: `espree` `^9.6.1` → `^10.4.0` (verify `yarn why espree` shows a single resolution — `rules/script-detect.js` uses espree as the oracle for `parsesAsScript`, which decides `es-module-required` and the `no-unused-vars` trust filter), `@eslint-community/eslint-utils` → `^4.10.0`, add `@eslint/js` (pinned) + `globals`. Pin `node-version` to `"22.13"`/`"24"` (not bare `"22"`) so A2's ESLint-10 peer range's Node floor `^22.13.0` is satisfied later.

### Definition of done

- `node test/selftest.js` green, with only the two intended `expected.json`/config deltas above.
- New selftest fixture: `review.js` run against a target directory outside the tool tree, asserting a known blocker is still reported as a blocker (not a new `test-cases/` fixture — extend Section 6 of `test/selftest.js`, which already runs in the CI topology).
- Gate still gates on a real PR with a known blocker.
- `caughtErrors: 'none'` in place.

### Review checklist

- **Perturbation:** revert the `cwd` fix — confirm the new outside-the-tree fixture fails.
- **Perturbation:** remove `caughtErrors: 'none'` — confirm a good fixture fails.
- Confirm nothing spreads `js.configs.recommended`; `@eslint/js` is a pinned dependency, not a peer.
- Spot-check `Program`/`FunctionDeclaration` scope handlers in `shoptet-no-core-overwrite.js` by hand.
- **Perturbation:** bypass the `childScopes.find` workaround in the `Program` handler and confirm the rule still fires on a module-mode file overwriting a core name.
- Confirm the espree bump deduped by reading `yarn.lock`, not `package.json`.
